claim: Wang et al. (2025) virtual brain twins for stimulation is a diagnostic modelling framework for estimating the epileptogenic zone network from stimulation-induced seizures; the abstract reports no clinical seizure-outcome data after model-guided therapeutic stimulation.

bibliographic_record.authors: Wang HE, Dollomaja B, Triebkorn P, Duma GM, Williamson A, Makhalova J, Lemarechal JD, Bartolomei F, Jirsa V.
bibliographic_record.title: Virtual brain twins for stimulation in epilepsy.
